# structyl

> Accessible React component library — headless primitives, Tailwind-styled components, runtime theming, and a first-class DataTable.

## Overview

structyl is an open-source TypeScript-first React component library. It is structured as a monorepo with independently-versioned packages. The library is WAI-ARIA compliant, supports dark mode out of the box, and is compatible with Next.js App Router and SSR.

Current version: 1.0.0
License: MIT
Documentation: https://structyl.dev
Source: https://github.com/structyl/structyl
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/org/structyl

## Installation

```bash
pnpm add @structyl/styled
# or
npm install @structyl/styled
```

## Packages

- `@structyl/styled` — Tailwind-styled component layer (main package for most users)
- `@structyl/primitives` — Unstyled, accessible headless behavior primitives
- `@structyl/themes` — Runtime theming system with CSS variables and ThemeProvider
- `@structyl/hooks` — 24+ SSR-safe, tree-shakeable React hooks
- `@structyl/data-table` — First-class DataTable with sorting, filtering, pagination, virtualization
- `@structyl/icons` — Icon set (Lucide re-export)
- `@structyl/utils` — Pure utility functions (cn, type guards, etc.)
- `@structyl/core` — Internal primitives (Slot, Primitive, createContext)
- `@structyl/cli` — shadcn-style installer CLI

## Key Features

- 90+ components across inputs, layout, navigation, overlays, feedback, and data display
- WAI-ARIA APG compliant — passes axe-core with zero violations
- Tailwind CSS v4 compatible
- Runtime theming with CSS custom properties — switch themes without a page reload
- Dark mode: system, light, or dark preference
- Compound component API using dot-notation (e.g. `<Dialog.Root>`, `<Dialog.Content>`)
- Supports `asChild` prop via Slot pattern — render any element while keeping behavior
- Controlled and uncontrolled state for all stateful components
- Full keyboard navigation for every interactive component
- SSR-safe — compatible with Next.js App Router and React Server Components
- TypeScript strict mode — no `any`, full type inference

### Inputs

Aspect Ratio, Box, Container, Grid, Masonry, Paper, Resizable, Scroll Area, Separator, Stack

### Navigation
App Bar, Bottom Navigation, Breadcrumb, Command, Link, Menubar, Navigation Menu, Pagination, Speed Dial, Stepper, Tabs, Toolbar

### Overlays
Alert Dialog, Backdrop, Context Menu, Dialog, Drawer, Dropdown Menu, Hover Card, Modal, Popover, Sheet, Tooltip

### Data display
Accordion, Avatar, Badge, Card, Carousel, Chart, Chip, Collapsible, Collapse, Data Table, Image List, List, SVG Icon, Table, Timeline, Tree, Typography

### Feedback
Alert, Circular Progress, Meter, Progress, Skeleton, Snackbar, Spinner, Toast

### Utilities
Click Away Listener, CSS Baseline, Init Color Scheme Script, No SSR, Popper, Portal, Transition

## Basic Usage

```tsx
import { Button } from '@structyl/styled';

export default function App() {
  return <Button variant="default">Click me</Button>;
}
```

## Theming

```tsx
// In your root layout
import { ThemeProvider } from '@structyl/themes';

export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
  return (
    <html>
      <body>
        <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="slate" defaultMode="system">
          {children}
        </ThemeProvider>
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
```

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is structyl?**
A: structyl is an accessible, TypeScript-first React component library with 90+ components. It provides headless primitives and Tailwind-styled wrappers, similar to Radix UI + shadcn/ui but as a full package.

**Q: How does structyl differ from shadcn/ui?**
A: structyl ships as actual npm packages you install, not copy-paste code. It also includes a runtime theming system, a first-class DataTable, and more components out of the box.

**Q: Is structyl compatible with Next.js App Router?**
A: Yes. All components with React hooks are marked with 'use client'. The library is SSR-safe and compatible with React Server Components.

**Q: Does structyl support dark mode?**
A: Yes. The theming system supports system, light, and dark modes out of the box. Theme switches happen without a page reload using CSS custom properties.

**Q: How do I customize the theme?**
A: Use the Theme Builder at https://structyl.dev/themes to generate custom CSS variables, or configure via ThemeProvider props.

**Q: Is structyl free?**
A: Yes. MIT license, free forever.
